shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' && sed -n '1,40p' package.json && npm test && npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
curl -fsS http://localhost:4173/ | head -n 8
curl -fsS http://localhost:4173/api/books
created=$(curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:4173/api/books -H '"'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"The Left Hand of Darkness\",\"author\":\"Ursula K. Le Guin\",\"notes\":\"Winter and estrangement.\"}')
book_id="'$(node -e "const chunks=[];process.stdin.on('"'data',c=>chunks.push(c)).on('end',()=>process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks)).id))\" <<< \""'$created")
curl -fsS "http://localhost:4173/api/books/$book_id"
curl -fsS -X POST "http://localhost:4173/api/books/$book_id/finish"
curl -fsS http://localhost:4173/api/books
status=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/book-nook-response -w '"'%{http_code}' -X POST http://localhost:4173/api/books -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"No author\"}')
printf 'validation_status=%s\\n' \""'$status"
cat /tmp/book-nook-response'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm test && node --check public/app.js && npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
